rows.displayName: A boundary-only obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding

claim.ja: framedな代数的双対球面を持つ有限円板配置について、出力framingも相対ホモトピー類も指定しない境界円周の局所平坦な互いに素な充填を排除する。F₂のnongoodnessと、無制限surgery・s-cobordismの両立否定を導く。
claim.en: Excludes disjoint locally flat fillings of specified boundary circles for a finite disk configuration with framed algebraic dual spheres, without output framing or relative homotopy constraints. Deduces nongoodness of F₂ and failure of the conjunction of unrestricted surgery and s-cobordism.

role.ja: 境界充填の実像からcut dataと全defect idealを取り、代数的置換・特殊化後のFrobenius–Koszul障害へ帰着する。
role.en: Actual filling images give cut data and full defect ideals; algebraic replacement and specialization lead to a Frobenius–Koszul obstruction.

rows.displayName: A marked tensor obstruction to four-dimensional disk embedding

claim.ja: 所定の代数的双対条件を満たす円板配置に、境界写像と誘導normal framingを保つ局所平坦な互いに素な置換が存在しないと主張する。置換円板の相対ホモトピー類は指定しない。
claim.en: Asserts that a disk configuration with the prescribed algebraic dual conditions admits no disjoint locally flat replacements preserving boundary maps and induced normal framings, without prescribing their relative homotopy classes.

role.ja: 独立な共役を含む境界法則、非被約critical schemeの標識、代数的potential、全active triplesの有限tensor障害を結ぶ。後続PD4稿へ中間結果を供給する。
role.en: Connects independently conjugated boundary laws, markings on nonreduced critical schemes, algebraic potentials, and a finite tensor obstruction for all active triples. Supplies intermediate inputs to the PD4 paper.

rows.displayName: A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model

claim.ja: 有限・向き付けられた4次元BGを持つ有限表示の整係数PD₄群を構成し、閉aspherical位相4多様体の基本群としての実現を排除する。
claim.en: Constructs a finitely presented integral PD₄ group with a finite oriented four-dimensional BG and excludes realization as the group of a closed aspherical topological four-manifold.

role.ja: marked論文の構成とtensor入力を標識付きchamberへ移し、反射・標識を保つ安定積・方向制御付き球面除去で非実現性へ進む。
role.en: Transfers the marked paper’s geometry and tensor interface to a marked chamber, then uses reflection, a marked stable product, and direction-controlled sphere removal.
